page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5g.16xlarge is a dedicated local-storage server instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The system is driven by a 3.2 GHz Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor built on the x86_64 architecture, supplying 64 dedicated virtual CPU cores. Memory configuration comprises 256 GB of system RAM, establishing a balanced general allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not feature graphics processing units or hardware accelerators.

Internal storage and peripheral interconnects are built for high input and output demands. The instance bundles 3839 GB of integrated local solid-state drive (SSD) storage, eliminating external network disk overhead for disk-bound read and write operations. Networking is configured with a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth, providing high-volume throughput across cloud infrastructure clusters. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned directly to the instance.

From an efficiency perspective, integrating nearly 4 TB of NVMe-class local SSD capacity alongside 64 dedicated compute threads reduces the costs associated with provisioning equivalent attached networked block volumes. The primary tradeoff lies in the host-bound lifecycle of local storage, requiring application-level redundancy to mitigate hardware failure risks. This architecture fits high-transaction database workloads, search index clusters, distributed Big Data analytics engines, and real-time event streaming systems.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5g.16xlarge is a local-storage-optimized virtual server powered by a 3.2 GHz Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor based on the x86_64 architecture. Delivering 64 dedicated virtual cores and 256 GB of system RAM, it operates with a balanced 4.0 GB per vCPU memory allocation. Storage is anchored by an integrated 3839 GB local SSD, allowing low-latency data access without relying on networked block volumes. The instance provides a high network capacity of 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth and runs on the KVM hypervisor with no GPU hardware present. With high-density compute cores, sizable memory, and bundled high-speed local disk capacity, ecs.i5g.16xlarge is suited for I/O-intensive workloads including transactional and NoSQL databases, in-memory data caching with disk persistence, search indexing engines, and distributed data processing pipelines.
